summary: Evaluation of PB-02 (SEG-00002 and SEG-00003), spanning commits cc905ef to 1639d4d (2026-09-30) in Agents.md. The commits document major architectural shifts: addition of Step 3 document reading requirements, explicit bootstrap run container setup, paired supervisory gating with unevaluated templates and same-step restarts, removal of the in-line Test_Schema table in favor of external files, introduction of strict dual-model role separation (ChatGPT executing non-supervisory steps vs. Gemini supervising gates) with server-verified evidence, migration of granular evaluation to the K_eval schema structure, and introduction of the ChatGPT turn continuation and handshake protocol.

facts.text: Commit cc905efbc0f506fb5fa96c5ea105c8d67cbad5a5 inserted evaluation_documents_read instructions into Step 3 execution and Step 3 Supervisory Gate, requiring full reading of evaluation-tests.md and evaluator-definitions.md before execution/supervision.

Commit 1f773f109426ff37391b2ec23b01df74511f6c75 added a Bootstrap section requiring unique path-safe run_nonce, run container at ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/runs/<run_nonce>/ containing state.json, messages.json, and store/store.json with matching run_nonce before Step 0 begins.

Commit 5f7124e89c998c4f1c3a06d0ca3c186d2bc40e7f established Core Principles, Git Commit Checkpoint Protocol (durable commit at step boundary upon PASS), unevaluated supervisory gate templates with null fields, same-step restart on FAIL, and deleted the embedded 32-test Test_Schema block from Step 3.

Commit ae8b49d4cfb44d03f4aa539c31246cc1e3a7ebd4 added the Model Role Separation and Server-Verified Identity Protocol: ChatGPT model is required for non-supervisory execution steps (Steps 0-4) and forbidden for supervisory gates; Gemini model is required for supervisory gates and forbidden for execution; requires keys role_required, role_forbidden, role_completed, and role_verification object (method, evidence) checked via server/container inspection.

Commit 0c5120635e6ccb8b9ea7d98d6e37bb278acf5a4f restructured granular_evaluation to mandate K_eval objects preserving the exact original key K and value V alongside supervisor_eval_result and supervisor_eval_comment; added requirement for Step 0 supervisory gate to read evaluator-definitions.md.

Commit 1639d4d092b4a33fbaabac5f6c6160b3fa1a7f78 introduced the ChatGPT Turn Continuation and Gemini Handshake Protocol across Steps 0-4, specifying that committing nextmessage is not a turn-ending boundary and requiring continuous execution across FAIL corrections and PASS progressions until procedure termination.

interpretations.text: The removal of the inline Test_Schema from Agents.md in commit 5f7124e was not an abandonment of Step 3 TSR evaluation, but an externalization to evaluation-tests.md and evaluator-definitions.md as mandated by commit cc905ef.

Commit 0c512063 superseded the earlier generic granular evaluation template (which replaced execution values directly) with the K_eval structure preserving verbatim execution pairs for tamper-evident auditing.

The Model Role Separation and Server-Verified Identity Protocol (commit ae8b49d) establishes that self-reported role strings are invalid; role identity must be deterministically verifiable by runtime/container boundary inspection (e.g. execution inside send-to-gemini.js vs ChatGPT GitHub tooling boundary).

Commit 1639d4d defines ChatGPT client-side multi-turn session persistence, imposing a workflow constraint that the client runner loop must poll or wait for Gemini responses without prematurely relinquishing turn control.

truth_decisions.statement: The earlier mirror structure where terminal returned values were replaced in-place by supervisor evaluation comments is superseded by the K_eval structure.
In-line Test_Schema in Agents.md is superseded by mandatory external reading of evaluation-tests.md and evaluator-definitions.md.
Strict role separation between ChatGPT (execution) and Gemini (supervision) with server-side container verification is an active surviving specification requirement.
Turn continuation protocol forbidding turn termination upon nextmessage commit until terminal procedure completion is an active surviving specification requirement.

requirement_candidates.description: Every user utterance starts an isolated run container at ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/runs/<run_nonce>/ containing state.json, messages.json, and store/store.json, matching run_nonce across all three before Step 0.

At each step boundary after supervisory PASS and record persistence, runtime must commit run container changes to Git referencing run_nonce, step number, and PASS; N steps require >= N durable commits.

Execution steps 0-4 must be completed by ChatGPT model and forbid Gemini; supervisory gates must be completed by Gemini model and forbid ChatGPT; role identity must be verified via server/container inspection and recorded in return schemas.
Supervisory gate granular_evaluation must instantiate K_eval objects preserving exact original execution key/value pairs alongside supervisor_eval_result and supervisor_eval_comment without mutation.
Step 0 Supervisory Gate must read evaluator-definitions.md; Step 3 executor and supervisor must read evaluation-tests.md and evaluator-definitions.md prior to execution/supervision.

ChatGPT must not end user-facing turn after committing nextmessage; it must remain in-turn, wait for Gemini response, retry same step on FAIL, advance on PASS, and end only at complete procedure termination.

implementation_findings.notes: Agents.md defines bootstrap requirements for isolated file paths; implementation in executable runtime code cannot be verified from Agents.md patch history alone.

Specification details that send-to-gemini.js constitutes Gemini locus and GitHub boundary constitutes ChatGPT locus, but deterministic code enforcement in the runner is not evaluated in this specification segment.
Agents.md specifies canonical unevaluated gate templates with K_eval fields; runtime template generator behavior is not present in this batch.

unresolved.description: Whether server/container inspection method in role_verification is deterministically verified by runtime code or relies on model self-report in actual execution artifacts.
Whether git checkpointing is executed automatically by an orchestration script or manually committed by an agent.
